name: matter-status
title: Matter status report
for_each: select id,ref as name from matters where status<>'closed' order by ref

sections.title: Matter
sections.sql: select ref,name,business_unit,owner,category,risk,status,opened_on,next_step,next_step_due,firm,budget_cents/100 budget,spent_cents/100 invoiced from v_matters where id=$1

sections.title: Key dates
sections.sql: select kind,due_on,description,done from key_dates where matter_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: History
sections.sql: select created_at::date as on_date,body from notes where matter_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Invoices
sections.sql: select f.name firm,i.invoice_no,i.invoice_date,i.amount_cents/100 amount,i.status from invoices i join firms f on f.id=i.firm_id where i.matter_id=$1 order by i.invoice_date

name: business-unit-report
title: Legal report for a business unit
for_each: select id,name from business_units order by ref

sections.title: Summary
sections.sql: select v.name,v.requests_90d,v.open_matters,v.high_risk,v.outside_spend_12m_cents/100 outside_spend_12m,v.avg_days_to_triage from v_business_units v join business_units b on b.ref=v.ref where b.id=$1

sections.title: Open matters
sections.sql: select m.ref,m.name,m.owner,m.risk,m.next_step,m.next_step_due from v_matters m join matters x on x.id=m.id where x.business_unit_id=$1 and x.status<>'closed' order by m.ref

sections.title: Requests in the last 90 days
sections.sql: select ref,title,received_on,status from requests where business_unit_id=$1 and received_on>=current_date-90 order by received_on

sections.title: Contracts ending in the next year
sections.sql: select ref,title,counterparty,end_on,auto_renews,end_on-notice_days notice_by from contracts where business_unit_id=$1 and status='signed' and end_on between current_date and current_date+365 order by end_on

name: renewal-review
title: Contract renewal review
for_each: select id,ref as name from contracts where status='signed' and auto_renews and end_on between current_date and current_date+180 order by end_on

sections.title: Contract
sections.sql: select ref,title,counterparty,business_unit,owner,end_on,notice_days,notice_by,annual_value_cents/100 annual_value,renewal_decision from v_renewals where id=$1

sections.title: Decision needed
sections.note: Record the decision with the renewal command: renew, renegotiate, notice given or let expire. Check the notice clause for the method of service.
sections.sql: select case when renewal_decision='' then 'No decision recorded' else 'Decision: '||renewal_decision end as status, notice_by-current_date as days_to_notice from v_renewals where id=$1

name: entity-register
title: Company register entry
for_each: select id,name from entities where status='active' order by ref
